title: NOT binds looser than IN: NOT ( FALSE ) IN { FALSE, TRUE } is NOT ( FALSE IN { ... } )
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", NOT ( FALSE ) IN { FALSE, TRUE } )

source.quote: NOT is not a real function; it is an operator that can be used as a function because of the equivalent syntax.
source.supports: the page shows NOT ( FALSE ) IN { FALSE, TRUE } as false and ( NOT FALSE ) IN { FALSE, TRUE } as true

source.quote: To perform the logical negation of the IN operator, put NOT in front of the entire expression.
source.supports: NOT in front negates the whole IN expression

notes: Read as a function call, NOT ( FALSE ) would be TRUE and TRUE IN { FALSE, TRUE } would be TRUE.
